Register a local directory as a plugin shadow, making nself build prefer it
over the registry version.

The link is recorded in ~/.nself/plugin-links.json and persists across CLI
invocations until you run nself plugin unlink <name>.

Modes:
  Default  Container-mount + air inside container (closer to production)
  --host   Run plugin process on host (faster but networking may differ)

Security: the local path must be readable and must contain a valid plugin.yaml.
Path traversal (e.g. ../../etc) is rejected.

Usage:
  nself plugin link <local-path> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for link
      --host   Use host-process mode instead of container-mount (macOS recommended for faster I/O)
      --list   List currently linked plugins

Global Flags:
      --json                      Machine-readable output: one JSON document on stdout (see JSON-Output)
      --no-deprecation-warnings   Suppress deprecation warnings (for scripted use)
      --no-monorepo               Disable automatic monorepo backend detection
